exact_blockers.detail: No Unreal Engine 4.26 host is installed (UE4_ROOT unset; no Epic Games install under C:\ or E:\ Program Files). The present CARLA 0.9.16 is a PACKAGED non-editor build (CarlaUE4-Win64-Shipping.exe only), which cannot execute UnrealEditor-Cmd, `make import`, or any cook. UE5 was not substituted and arbitrary stock UE4 was not used.

tools/tile_frame_consistency.py derives placement from the bbox centroid of each tile's own building geometry and compares those centroids. That measures building-distribution asymmetry between neighbouring 1000 m cells, not world displacement. The 27/31 'FAIL' seams (max 485.84 m) are not evidence of misplacement. A control-anchor metric (OSM node ids / XODR road geometry) is required. The governed 10 m threshold was NOT changed.
exact_blockers.unblock_procedure: Regenerate the governed tile release retaining per-tile OSM XML, then match named OSM node anchors through source -> canonical -> rebase -> tile-local -> FBX -> package -> expected CARLA world.
